name: Netlink Solutions (India) Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1984, Netlink Solutions (India) 
Ltd is a software and print media company[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
NSIL is in the business of Web site design, 
 SEO, Server Space, Domain Booking & renewal, organizing exhibitions, and providing exhibition management services. The surplus funds of the company are invested in the listed equity shares of the companies

pros: Stock is trading at 1.18 times its book value
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.2%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.56% over past five years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -6.70%
Working capital days have increased from 1,614 days to 3,752 days
